places.name: Irrational Games (now Ghost Story Games)
places.connection: Irrational Games, the developer of Bioshock Infinite, was based here during the game's development.

places.name: Columbia
places.connection: Columbia is the fictional floating city depicted in Bioshock Infinite.

places.name: FASA Studio
places.connection: The aesthetic and themes of Bioshock Infinite were inspired by the 1893 World's Fair in Chicago.

places.name: Library of Congress
places.connection: The architecture and design of Columbia in Bioshock Infinite were influenced by historical American architecture, similar to that of the Library of Congress.

places.name: Columbia University
places.connection: The name 'Columbia' for the floating city in Bioshock Infinite may have been inspired by Columbia University, reflecting American ideals.
